label: preparing
what: Builder placed a series of lanterns, plausibly preparing lighting for the great hall lighting inspection with the builder scheduled for Day 1 at 18:00. Freight supplied bread to builder, though the record does not establish this was knowingly connected to that preparation. No two-or-more-person preparation hidden from the mayor is supported: the recorded inspection was approved and communicated to the mayor, and the builder appears to have acted alone in placing lanterns.
